verdict.rationale: Orama is an open-source search library that bills itself as adding "fast, relevant search" to applications. It can run directly in the browser, which enables client-side search, and it offers typo tolerance, which suits partially typed queries. However, the evidence never claims millisecond latency or describes as-you-type, prefix or keystroke-level search. missing for 10: documented millisecond/latency benchmarks, explicit as-you-type or prefix-matching support, independent or hands-on performance corroboration.
